Full tests now pass in 14.92s (318 passed, 4 skipped), down 25.55s, and invoice tests complete in about 1.12s. The primary goal—splitting monolithic `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers—has not yet been implemented.

An invoice-sync integration test intermittently returns 409 instead of 202. Investigation found `InvoiceSyncService.submit` creates a session and forwards an idempotency key but does not persist completed responses, making completed-response replay likely relevant.

For the separately requested retention procedure, only step 1 has run: 1,842,032 rows predate 2024-01-01. Steps 2–8 remain pending and must be executed in order.
